description: One-call KYB check of a company: EU VAT number validated in the official VIES register (company name and registered address), that name screened on the OFAC, EU and UK sanctions lists, the address geocoded by the national geocoder, the website domain's age and registrar (RDAP), its email authentication score, and plain risk flags (invalid VAT, sanctions match, domain younger than 180 days, name not matching the domain, spoofable email). Address geocoding covers US, CA, GB, FR, ES, NL, CH, NO, EE and PL; other countries return geocode null with a note. ~1-3 s. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.01/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/business-check.

address.description: Optional address to geocode instead of the registered one

companyName.description: Optional company name to screen on sanctions lists when the VAT register shows no name

domain.description: Company website or e-mail domain, e.g. google.com

vatNumber.description: EU VAT number with country prefix, e.g. FR40303265045 (also NO/CH/GB formats)

name: business_check
title: Business Check - EU VAT, sanctions, domain age, risk flags
